caption: The drawing depicts a section of an ornate iron railing or fence, rendered in grayscale tones. The railing features two vertical posts on either side; the left post is highly decorative, with carved spirals, bulbous segments, and a pointed finial on top, while the right post is simpler and cylindrical with a horizontal top bar connecting both posts. The central section of the railing contains a square frame, within which diagonal and horizontal bars intersect to form an 'X' shape and a cross, originating from a central circular node. At the ends of the diagonal and horizontal bars are stylized leaf or fleur-de-lis motifs. Additional small spirals or curls fill each of the four corners of the square frame. The drawing is on a pale or off-white background, and the objects are depicted in varying shades of dark gray to black.
title: Fence
